inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, Vault tree, Obsidian core/community plugin configs, template folder inspection

anchors.why: Describes the repo as a scrubbed Obsidian vault template and warns it is not frequently updated.
Lists plugin dependencies such as spaced repetition, importer, icon folder, Excalidraw, templater, calendar, homepage, and advanced slides.
Records core plugin choices including properties, daily notes, templates, bookmarks, file recovery, etc.
Template includes 00 MOCs, 01 Projects, 02 Areas, 03 Resources, 04 Permanent, 05 Fleeting, 06 Daily, 07 Archives, 99 Meta.
Template area contains Daily and Unique note templates.

known_limits: Template is explicitly not kept frequently updated.
Bundled plugins are runtime dependencies and should not be adopted without plugin review.
Folder taxonomy is a template suggestion, not VAKS architecture.
